steps.what: Show the requirement already written for this hardware or software test.
Design and conduct the hardware or software tests.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the requirement already written for the test. The systems engineer designs the hardware or software test and conducts it. The requirement line is not the test. A test with no written requirement is designed by the engineer, not by a generated script.
tasks.previous_blocker: A previous test script was rerun because finding the requirement took longer than writing a new one.
tasks.enabler_now: A written requirement can be shown. Designing and conducting the test still take the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A hardware test that the requirement describes poorly still has to be designed on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs and conducts the test. The requirement is not a script.
tasks.altitude: Test design and the test run stay with the engineer. The stored requirement is only the line already written.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Execute a test the engineer has designed.
reach.learn: A requirement line is not the test.

evidence.claim: Showing a written requirement is a lookup. It does not design or conduct the test.
Hardware and software tests are designed and conducted by the engineer. A generated script is not that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The test id and the requirement only if it is already written. The screen does not invent a test step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the requirement in the document store before designing the test.
unknowns: Whether hardware tests and software tests share one requirement record.
research_questions: Who conducts the test when the bench is in another team's room?

already_counted.description: Designing and conducting the tests stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop requirements for tests that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still designs and conducts the hardware or software tests. Only showing a requirement that was already written is removed. A test with no written requirement saves none of that design or that run.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the measures already stored for the existing system.
Evaluate the existing system and suggest changes to meet requirements.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows measures already stored for the existing system. The systems engineer evaluates effectiveness and suggests changes that meet the organisational requirements. The measures are not the evaluation. A system with no stored measure is evaluated by the engineer, not given a generated score.
tasks.previous_blocker: A change was suggested from memory because the measures lived in a monthly pack nobody opened.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored measures can be shown. Evaluating them and suggesting a change still take the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A requirement the measures do not cover cannot be judged from the table.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer evaluates and suggests the change. The measures are not the suggestion.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation and the suggested change stay with the engineer. Stored measures are visible and are not a verdict.

reach.task: Read a measure the engineer will evaluate.
reach.learn: A stored measure is not the suggested change.

evidence.claim: Showing stored measures is a lookup. It does not evaluate effectiveness or suggest a change.
The engineer evaluates the existing system. A missing measure is not a pass and is not a failing score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The system id and measures already stored for it. The screen does not score a gap as zero. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the measures on the operations system before writing the suggestion.
unknowns: Whether organisational requirements are stored beside the measures or in a separate note.
research_questions: Who accepts a suggested change when it crosses another team's system?

already_counted.description: Evaluating the system and suggesting changes stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop measures for systems that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still evaluates the existing system and still suggests changes. Only showing measures already stored is removed. A system with no stored measure saves none of that evaluation, and a gap is not a score.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document the design and the install.

steps.what: Draft installation instructions only from sentences the held design states.

loop.input: a page id and one sentence from that page
loop.output: a sentence kept only when that page states it
loop.check: The sentence cites a page id and the page text contains it.
loop.stop: Stop when there is no page id, or the page does not state the sentence. The engineer writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which sentence is absent from the held design, so it would document a step the design does not state.

steps.what: Document the design specifications and accept the system information.
File the accepted installation instructions and the design note.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store drafts an installation sentence only when the held design note states it. The systems engineer documents the design specifications and the other system information, and accepts the text. Only that accepted version is filed. A step the design does not state is written by the engineer, not invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Installation instructions were copied from another system and named a step this design does not have.
tasks.enabler_now: A held design note can supply a sentence it states. The document still has to be accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Writing the step the design note leaves out stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer documents and accepts the text. A quoted sentence is not the finished instruction.
tasks.altitude: Documentation stays with the engineer until the text is accepted. Filing stores that version and no other.

reach.task: Hand over a design the engineer has documented and accepted.
reach.learn: A quoted sentence is not the installation instruction.

evidence.claim: A sentence may be kept only when the held design note states it. The draft is not the document.
The engineer still documents the specifications and still accepts the text before it is filed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The design-note id and a sentence that note states. A sentence with no note is not kept. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the design note in the document store before writing the installation instructions.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether installation instructions and design specifications are one document or two.
research_questions: Which design notes are allowed to be quoted into an instruction?

already_counted.description: Documenting the specifications and accepting the text stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop instructions whose design note has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: document version and the design note ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still documents the design specifications and still accepts the text. The draft may repeat only a sentence the held design states, and only that accepted version is filed. A note that does not state the step saves none of the writing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show finding ids already stored for these software components.
Perform security analyses of the developed or packaged software components.
File the accepted analysis and the finding ids it cites.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows finding ids a scan has already stored. That scan's run is not the engineer's time and is not counted. The systems engineer performs the security analysis of the developed or packaged component and accepts the text. Only that version is filed. A finding id is not the analysis, and a component with no finding is not given a clean result.
tasks.previous_blocker: A scan list was pasted into the report and treated as the analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored finding ids can be shown. The analysis still has to be written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: What a finding means for this component, including one the scan did not name, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer writes the analysis. The finding list is not that analysis.

ambition.what: Each stored finding for a packaged component is read in the week the scan stored it.

tasks.altitude: The security analysis stays with the engineer. Filing happens only after that text is accepted.

reach.task: Read a finding the engineer will analyse.
reach.learn: A finding id is not the analysis.

evidence.claim: Showing stored finding ids is a lookup. The scan that stored them is existing runtime and is not saved labour.
The security analysis is written and accepted by the engineer. A finding list is not the analysis, and a generated fix is not accepted code.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The component id and finding ids already stored for it. A component with no finding is not marked clean. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the finding list on the operations system before writing the analysis.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether developed components and packaged components share one finding list.
research_questions: Who accepts the analysis when the component belongs to a supplier?

already_counted.description: Performing the security analysis and accepting the text stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop analyses whose finding ids have been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: analysis version and the finding ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still performs the security analysis and still accepts the text. Only showing finding ids already stored, and filing the accepted analysis, is removed. The scan's run is not counted. No finding does not mean a clean component.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The systems engineer still designs and runs tests, still evaluates the system, and still writes the security analysis. A stored requirement or a stored finding can be opened. It is not the test and it is not the analysis.
reach: Software quality assurance analysts conduct tests, and this job learns the engineer still designs the test rather than inheriting a generated script.
Information security analysts study findings, and this job learns a finding id is not the security analysis.
skills_to_grow: Design the test and conduct it, and do not treat a requirement line as the test.
Evaluate the existing system and suggest a change only after reading the measures.
Write the security analysis from the findings, and file only the accepted text.
role.ambitious_version: Tests, evaluation, documentation, and security analysis stay with the engineer. Stored requirements and findings only show what was already recorded.
